status: Design proposal only. Existing Unity ThirdDrain remains arrival preview.
unit: H = standing character height, same world scale as Level02
camera: Orthographic side view perpendicular to back wall; camera zoom does not change world scale

optics.mirrorAngle: fixed 45-degree backslash in side view; vertical incoming ray reflects horizontally right
optics.lowRayBlockedBy: front of jump platform 3 at x=24.5; top y=1.6

controls.winch: E engages; W/S raises/lowers the reflector; release locks ratchet; E leaves
controls.movement: A/D, Space jump; previous 3-second light form retained

recovery.checkpoint: after setting reflector, preserve lamp and lift state

narrative: A cropped tail-root scale drinks the light; its local skin fold relaxes upward and uncovers an existing outlet.
